caption: This shoyu broth, golden-brown and glossy, floats with noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with red rim and green speckles, tender chashu pork and dark green nori sit beside a white ceramic spoon on a wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven surface texture.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slight curling edges.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, green speckles, and red "ARASAKI" text, smooth surface with slight sheen.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
